thread:
Maya: Morning — finalizing the X + LinkedIn schedule for the benchmark webinar next Tue. Need final assets by EOD: hero image (1200x627), 3 tweet-thread drafts, LinkedIn long post, and confirmation on HubSpot routing for inbound leads. Can we lock this today?

Jonah: I can draft the 3-thread takes. Quick q — do we lead with headline benchmark numbers or tease and push to the webinar CTA?

Ava: Lead with top-3 findings up front (short bullets), then CTA to register. LinkedIn should include a short methodology note and a slide/asset link.

Sam: Scheduling windows suggestion: X posts at 09:30 PT, 12:00 PT, 17:30 PT. LinkedIn home post at 10:00 PT. Plan one booster post 24h later. We can A/B caption on X — track engagement.

Rachel: I can own HubSpot routing. Which form/url will social link to? Share the UTM pattern and I'll set up queues.

Maya: Use /webinar-signup with UTM params: `?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium={channel}`. Tag X leads as `social_x_benchmark` so DB can route to SDR queue.

Rachel: Got it. If we A/B captions, send me suffixes so I can make separate lists/workflows.

Jonah: Drafts below — three short thread options. Tell me which tone: data-forward, product-forward, or customer-story.

Jonah: (Thread A - data-forward)
1) We ran 1000 production requests across 3 model configs. Result: median latency down 2.1x, cost per token down 27%.
2) These numbers matter if you care about cost & SLA — join our webinar to see configurations and benchmark rig.
3) Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar-signup?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=x

Jonah: (Thread B - customer-story)
1) A fintech app cut inference cost by 30% after switching to batch+kv caching.
2) We’ll walk through the exact prompts, configs, and tradeoffs.
3) Sign up and bring your questions. https://redwood.ai/webinar-signup?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=x

Jonah: (Thread C - product-forward)
1) Want predictable latency at lower cost? We built an inference stack that does both.
2) Live demo + benchmark walk-through next Tue.
3) Save your seat: https://redwood.ai/webinar-signup?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=x

Ava: I like A + LinkedIn longform that expands on methods (batching, caching, quantization). Jonah can adapt.

Sam: I'll queue these times in the scheduler. CSV for scheduler import (please confirm file names and image assets):
```
Time,Channel,CopyFile,Image
2026-06-01T16:30:00Z,X,threadA.txt,hero_v1.jpg
2026-06-01T19:00:00Z,LinkedIn,lnkd_long.md,hero_v1.jpg
2026-06-02T16:30:00Z,X,booster.txt,hero_v2.jpg
```

Maya: asset names: hero_v1.jpg (main), hero_v2.jpg (booster). Jonah — include alt text for accessibility please.

Jonah: alt text examples added to drafts doc. Also: should we pin a comment with the slide deck?

Ava: yes pin slides and include a slide image on LinkedIn. Slide deck link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/benchmark-slides

Rachel: For HubSpot routing I need a separate UTM for each caption variant. Suggest `_v1`, `_v2`, `_v3`. e.g. `?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=x&utm_content=v1`

Maya: good call — Jonah append `_vX` to each thread file name. Rachel — once you create lists, tag `social_x_benchmark` and `source_variant:v1` so ops can filter.

social-bot: Scheduled 4 posts to the queue. Import succeeded. Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/benchmark-social-schedule

Sam: Engagement playbook — simple: 1) 1 hour after post: triage comments, respond to question-style comments, upvote noteworthy replies. 2) 3 hours after: collect top 5 replies and tag to #sales-inbound as "hot". 3) 24h booster: reshare top replies + CTA. Will draft doc and share. :thumbsup:

Maya: perfect. Action items: Jonah finalize drafts + alt text (by 4pm), Rachel set up HubSpot lists and routing (by 5pm), Sam import schedule and engagement doc (by EOD). Thanks team!
